official_title: To direct the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a grant program to, through subgrants to eligible entities, improve certain impacts of participation in programs related to physical activity or youth sports and increase access to youth sports, and for other purposes.
short_title: Sports Training, Recreation, and Opportunities for the Next Generation Act
